definition: Graded bets must reach minimum sample before any reward tier
threshold: >=100 graded bets OR >=4 completed weeks of official results
evidence_or_missing_evidence: Graded bets so far: 0; Week-8 official results exist (14 games); Week-10 unplayed

definition: Risk-adjusted return must exceed breakeven at standard price
evidence_or_missing_evidence: No graded bets yet; breakeven rates documented in repo research

definition: Model must beat closing market line more often than chance
threshold: CV of CLV > 0 over >=20 paired observations
evidence_or_missing_evidence: No official public source publishes market lines (Q07); policy decision S04 required

definition: Leg outcomes must be tested for dependence before parlay staking
threshold: Pairwise leg correlation computed (C05) and below pre-registered threshold
evidence_or_missing_evidence: C05 blank until >=4 weeks official results collected (S03)

definition: Strategy edge must survive exclusion of one-score-game luck
threshold: Performance unchanged within noise when luck-index extremes excluded
evidence_or_missing_evidence: Requires graded results plus luck_vs_skill.csv residuals

definition: Every input value in a strategy's data rows carries an official source link
threshold: 100% rows with official source_url; unconfirmable cells blank and flagged
evidence_or_missing_evidence: verify_nfl_desk.py checks every table row for a source link before merge

definition: No strategy grades until official inactives confirm the starter assumption
threshold: Official inactives captured for the game

definition: Strategy inputs must come from an official or user-approved source
threshold: Source exists and is approved before strategy activates
